title: Pixel Perfection x AD ASTRA
description: Ad Astra, but for Pixel Perfection.
body:
**_(NOTE: THIS IS A PROJECT IN BETA PHASE)_** This is a **compatibility** pack between [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) and [Pixel Perfection Legacy](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-legacy). Try my new Texture pack **Pixel Perfection Fidelity**

This resource pack adds textures compatible with Pixel Perfection Legacy texture pack and it is meant to be used alongside it. It changes the textures of Ad Astra to make them look less saturated and somewhat medieval, adapting it to work perfectly with Pixel Perfection. So far the features present in the pack are: - GUI integration - Most of the naturally generated building blocks - 2/3 of items Future features to be implemented: - Retexturing entities - Armor - Machinery blocks - Particles - Paintings For any bugs or feedback, reach out on my discord. # **MY OTHER PACKS** - [Pixel Perfection Fidelity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-fidelity) - [Pixel Perfection x FARMER'S DELIGHT](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixelperfectionxfarmersdelight) - [Pixel Perfection x THE TWILIGHT FOREST](https://modrinth.com/project/pixel-perfection-x-the-twilight-forest) - [Pixel Perfection x DEHYDRATION](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-x-dehydration) - [Pixel Perfection x CONTROLIFY](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-x-controlify) - [PPL Alternative GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-alternative-gui) - [PPL Compat Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-compatibility-pack) - [PPL Hodgepodge](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-hodgepodge) - [PPL Better Grass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-better-grass) - [PPL Custom Theme for Jade](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-custom-theme-for-jade)
